title: The v1 partition-revoke hook does not block unassignment
answers: Can a partition-revoke callback delay Kafka v1 unassignment?
Where do consumers register cleanup after losing partitions?
Why can revoked-partition cleanup still be running after a Kafka rebalance?
body:
nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/index.ts:KafkaConsumerInterface.connect exposes an optional async onPartitionsRevoked callback receiving revoked Assignment entries.
nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/consumer-v1.ts:KafkaConsumer.connect stores that callback; KafkaConsumer invokes it after unassigning partitions and resetting rebalance coordination, without awaiting completion.
KafkaConsumer catches callback failures and logs partition_revoked_handler_failed; preserve this error handling when changing hook dispatch.
Cleanup using this interface must account for implementation timing: the description specifies that v2 awaits the hook before unassignment, while v1 does not. Do not rely on the shared interface to guarantee either ordering.
applies: Partition-revocation callbacks registered through KafkaConsumerInterface.connect, especially cleanup requiring ordering relative to unassignment.
